## Session of 2026-10-04, morning: from reading clusters to a thesis frame

*2026-10-07 01:14:40*

*Reconstructed on 2026-10-07 from the shared exchange (https://chatgpt.com/share/6ac5887a-48cc-83ea-9184-cf6afcfbd5c4), as a
demonstration of how the record would have documented it ([ADR-032](../../record/decisions.d/ADR-032.md)). Turn labels
count the owner's turns (U) and the assistant's replies (A) in order. Times are
UTC.*

**05:01–07:44, U1–U22.** The owner asked for article proposals grounded in this
record, then opened the whole of it to the assistant.

- **A rival framing, rejected.** At A8 the assistant set Brooks, Kelso and Levin
  up as "three different ways of understanding what the whole is"
  ([CLAIM-110](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-110.md)). The owner objected at U7: "perfectly mutually compatible"
  ([CLAIM-045](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-045.md)). A10 conceded. A1 had called them complementary first;
  the reversal and its reversal are why `complements` is a relation now.
- **The frame.** U9: "What is it like to be 'Microsoft'?" ([QUESTION-019](../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-019.md)), with
  Microsoft as the target case ([CASE-014](../../record/cases.d/CASE-014.md)).
- **The thesis that lasted.** U12, from Stability AI: an expectation over the
  members' intentions does not produce the whole's ([CLAIM-030](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-030.md)). U13
  added CoreWeave. Both were real companies with contested facts, and at U15
  the owner replaced them with invented ones ([CASE-025](../../record/cases.d/CASE-025.md) stands in for
  [CASE-007](../../record/cases.d/CASE-007.md), [CASE-006](../../record/cases.d/CASE-006.md) for [CASE-028](../../record/cases.d/CASE-028.md)), and turned the
  analysis inward: the psyche as a collective of conflicting policies.
- **Affect.** U19–U20 proposed affective states as properties of organized
  systems, read through Frijda ([CLAIM-039](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-039.md)).

What the record would have prevented: the List paper the assistant later
flagged as a close neighbour of the working title (A40) was already in the
record when the title was fixed (A14–A16).

## Session of 2026-10-04, afternoon: from organizational affect to will

*2026-10-07 01:14:42*

*Reconstructed on 2026-10-07 from the shared exchange; see the entry for the
morning session for provenance and labels.*

**16:11–18:58, U23–U43.**

- **The affect line deepened, and then stopped growing.** Corporate sensory
  organs and immune-like incident response (U24), the global workspace (U25),
  and the owner's point that access is compartmented ([CLAIM-003](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-003.md)),
  shown by driving home while daydreaming ([CASE-033](../../record/cases.d/CASE-033.md)). Entrainment and
  cadence (U27). Holobiont and coral reef (U29–U30, [CASE-024](../../record/cases.d/CASE-024.md)).
- **Will enters.** U32 brought in Frankfurt; U33 asked for an account of will.
  The assistant's draft (A108) and the owner's operational definition at U34
  gave will as a higher-order attractor ([TERM-003](../../record/terms.d/TERM-003.md), [CLAIM-012](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-012.md)).
- **The objection that would not stay answered.** A112: does every control
  system then have a will ([CLAIM-010](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-010.md))? The owner bit the bullet at U34
  ([CLAIM-062](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-062.md)) and the assistant withdrew the objection at A116. It
  came back at A118 and A147 regardless, unlinked to its withdrawal.
- **Divergence across scales.** U37 (enshittification as a sign that corporate
  organisms are different kinds of things) and U39 (cancer, autoimmunity,
  ecosystem collapse: "the reverse is also true") became [CLAIM-060](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-060.md).

The reef's job changed four times in this session and the next. Filed once,

<a id="20261009012618"></a>

## Session of 2026-10-09: What Survives Translation? read against its references

*2026-10-09 01:26:18*

*The manuscript was read from the exchange that drafted it
(https://chatgpt.com/share/6ac83fde-b150-83ea-9653-dda294f0883e), in its final
form: Abstract, §§1–12 and the reference list.*

**The order of work was deliberate.** The owner had the manuscript's 24
references filed and read first, without the manuscript, so that each reading
would not be tilted by the use the manuscript makes of it (curation entry of
2026-10-09). The manuscript came afterwards, and this session puts it beside
those readings.

**What was filed.**

- The title question is [QUESTION-002](../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-002.md).
- The central thesis is [CLAIM-115](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-115.md). It rests on relational identity
  ([CLAIM-082](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-082.md)) and on decision-relative fidelity ([CLAIM-050](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-050.md)).
- Five more theses carry the load-bearing citations: contextuality
  ([CLAIM-037](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-037.md)), conservation ([CLAIM-107](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-107.md)), compositional generation
  ([CLAIM-123](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-123.md)), serial transmission ([CLAIM-090](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-090.md)) and the evaluation
  gap ([CLAIM-013](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-013.md)).
- All the theses are Proposed and in the work `what-survives-translation`, on
  a new line, `pragmatic-transport`.

**What the readings say against it.** Five points, each filed as a granted
claim that objects to the thesis it qualifies. None of them defeats a thesis.
Each says the manuscript cites a work for more than the work shows, or for
something slightly different.

- **Saussure** ([CLAIM-072](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-072.md)). "Purely differential" is said of signifier
  and signified taken apart; the sign as a whole is "un fait positif". Value
  is not signification, and the referent is not Saussure's contrast at all.
- **Contextuality-by-Default** ([CLAIM-069](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-069.md)). The 2016 criterion was
  superseded by multimaximal couplings. That leaves the parity example alone,
  but not the general cover.
- **Baez and Fong** ([CLAIM-094](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-094.md)). Kf = f is the mean-only condition. The
  cited theorem's own counterexample shows mean conservation is weaker than
  symmetry.
- **Iterated learning** ([CLAIM-066](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-066.md)). Kirby, Cornish and Smith measured
  no prior, and their structure came from the experimenter's homonym filter.
  Griffiths and Kalish's convergence to the prior holds for sampling learners
  only.
- **T2I-CompBench** ([CLAIM-097](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-097.md)). It has an interaction category, scored
  by CLIPScore and near human ceiling. That category is the baseline Case III
  extends, not an object-centered one.

**What the readings support.**

- Baez and Fong is cited accurately, diagonal restriction included.
- The direction of Blackwell's theorem the manuscript uses is the right one.
  The 1953 paper also anticipates the restricted family Q: its k-decision
  orders, and Theorem 10 for two states.
- The hedges on Composable Diffusion are better than the paper's own. The
  paper never examines conditional independence at the noisy state.
- Both text-to-image readings back the premise that embedding similarity
  misses binding and relations.
- Du Bois is paraphrased fairly. In the reading, the stance triangle is one
  act with two evaluative sides and an alignment scale.

**Not filed as claims, for the owner.**

- **Four references are never cited in the body:** Cover and Thomas, Fritz,
  Gutt and Tishby, Pereira and Bialek. Fritz's Markov categories
  ([THEORY-157](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-157.md)) would suit §6, which defines transport as stochastic kernels
  commuting with restriction. That is a construction in a Markov category,
  and the manuscript does not say so.
- **Seven cited works are unread here, so the claims they ground stand on a
  work cited without a reading:**
  - Austin and Goffman (§§1–2);
  - Hofstadter (§1);
  - Lévi-Strauss (§2);
  - Bartlett (§8);
  - Torgersen (§5);
  - Wyner and Ziv (§5).

  No lawful copy was reachable; each LIT lists what was tried.
- **The manuscript's own algebra holds.** I checked three pieces:
  - The commutator identity of §9,
    Φ[A,B] − [A′,B′]Φ = E_A B + A′E_B − E_B A − B′E_A. Expanding ΦAB and ΦBA
    through E_A = ΦA − A′Φ and E_B = ΦB − B′Φ gives exactly that.
  - The drift recursion of §8.
  - The Σε_i expectation bound of §4.

  I did not check Propositions 1 and 2 beyond their proof sketches. The
  sketches are sound for marginal consistency, and the manuscript claims
  nothing more.

*Correction, 2026-10-09: the manuscript read here was the main body of draft C7
only. C7 also has four technical appendices (A, compatibility preservation; B,
conservation and drift bounds; C, information-theoretic conventions; D,
conditional composition and cross-modal controls) that the extracted text
omitted. Two findings above change with them. Tishby, Pereira and Bialek are
used in Appendix C's bottleneck objective. The proofs of Propositions 1 and 2
are in Appendix A, and were checked in the entry for U38–U39
([CLAIM-121](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-121.md), [CLAIM-070](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-070.md)).*

Survives Translation?" (https://chatgpt.com/share/6ac83fde-b150-83ea-9653-dda294f0883e).
Turn labels are those of the decoded transcript: owner turns U, assistant

repeats A45's tail. The outline lineage here is A48 (outline v3) and A52
(outline v4). No turn in this stretch points to this record.*

**2026-10-08 19:38–19:56, U17–U21.** Five owner turns in eighteen minutes. Two
of them changed the argument: U19, which changed how it is written, and U20,
which changed what it claims.

- **Language models (U17; A43–A45).** The owner proposed the LLM's response to
  context as "functionally a parameterized frame" ([CLAIM-029](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-029.md)). The
  assistant made it the primary formal example, built an analogy on it
  ([ARG-008](../../record/arguments.d/ARG-008.md) → [CLAIM-058](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-058.md)) and limited the analogy in the same breath
  ([CLAIM-085](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-085.md)).
  - What lasted: context and interpreter as separate sources of change
    ([CLAIM-118](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-118.md), manuscript §5).
  - What did not: contextual versus adaptational history ([CLAIM-074](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-074.md)), a
    text as a distribution over situations ([CLAIM-111](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-111.md)), the three
    language-model experiments ([CASE-005](../../record/cases.d/CASE-005.md)), convention induction
    ([QUESTION-024](../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-024.md)), and string concatenation as a trivial level of
    noncommutativity ([TERM-024](../../record/terms.d/TERM-024.md), version 3).
  - A45 §10 gave "frame" three senses (representational, inferential,
    dynamical) and read the whole conversation as "a gradual discovery that
    these three operations should not be conflated". The middle sense is
    [TERM-011](../../record/terms.d/TERM-011.md). It fills the gap between the frame that obtains
    ([TERM-030](../../record/terms.d/TERM-030.md)) and the intervention ([TERM-018](../../record/terms.d/TERM-018.md)). The manuscript has
    none of the three-way splits.
- **Outline v3 (U18; A48).** Mostly integration. The thesis became
  [CLAIM-065](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-065.md), which now sits between [CLAIM-083](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-083.md) and the transport
  thesis in the chain to [CLAIM-115](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-115.md). Three entries record things it said
  that did not last: the ambiguity case ([CASE-022](../../record/cases.d/CASE-022.md)), the commutator caveat
  restated ([CLAIM-011](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-011.md)), and its closing worry about building the
  preferred fidelity into the measurement ([QUESTION-005](../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-005.md)).
- **No hedging (U19; A49).** The owner: "rather than providing our readers with
  a map with which to attack our work ... generally withhold hedging"
  ([CLAIM-095](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-095.md)). A49: "define rather than defend; demonstrate rather than
  disclaim", with the guard that this is not "concealing limitations".
  - Its best result was the admissible transport ([CLAIM-077](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-077.md)), the collapse
    objection answered by a definition.
  - The frame got a third formal definition, a parameterized family of
    contexts ([TERM-025](../../record/terms.d/TERM-025.md)), which formalized the owner's U17 phrase and was
    gone two replies later.
  - The sweep from v3 to v4 removed the hedges it was aimed at: the failure
    conditions (now noted on [CASE-029](../../record/cases.d/CASE-029.md)), the H1–H4 ladder (left uncoded)
    and the novelty section ([CLAIM-023](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-023.md)). It also removed two things that
    were not hedges, the circularity objection and the normative/descriptive
    split ([CLAIM-085](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-085.md)). A49 said the failure conditions would return as
    decision rules; they did not.
- **Transport (U20; A50).** The owner, quoting A49's compositional theorem
  ([CLAIM-067](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-067.md)): "that's just a similarity constraint, not an equivalence.
  This is why the game 'telephone' works" ([CASE-015](../../record/cases.d/CASE-015.md)). Accepted as "an
  important correction".
  - Fidelity became graded and directed ([TERM-015](../../record/terms.d/TERM-015.md), [CLAIM-106](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-106.md)). Φ
    became a transport ([TERM-008](../../record/terms.d/TERM-008.md)), the owner's word and the manuscript's
    central term.
  - The drift recursion came in ([CLAIM-056](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-056.md)) with the serial-reconstruction
    line and Bartlett and Kirby, which "may actually be more central to your
    telephone-game insight than quantum cognition".
  - A50 dropped the triangle inequality in the same reply whose bounds assume
    one ([QUESTION-017](../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-017.md)).
  - Two of its readings are recovered: attraction toward conventional stances
    ([CLAIM-068](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-068.md)), and identity as a family of relations, with each
    reconstruction becoming the next source ([CLAIM-002](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-002.md)).
- **Outline v4 (U21; A52).** The transport thesis ([CLAIM-101](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-101.md)), three
  running cases (Henley, the telephone game, the language model), and a
  question new in v4, contextuality under transmission ([QUESTION-004](../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-004.md)). A52
  §1.1's central question, "What must survive a transformation for the
  resulting utterance to remain recognizably a translation of the original?",
  is the nearest ancestor of [QUESTION-002](../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-002.md).

**Edits to earlier entries.** [CLAIM-083](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-083.md) is now superseded by
[CLAIM-065](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-065.md) rather than directly by [CLAIM-115](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-115.md), and [CLAIM-115](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-115.md)

**2026-10-08 19:59–21:01, U22–U29.**

- **The first full draft (U22; C1).** "flesh this out into a full manuscript
  draft. start with the appendices". C1 was a 12-page build script. It
  absorbed U20 (no symmetry or invertibility axiom; equivalence as a limiting
  case) and applied U19 as "exclude by construction". Several of its
  qualifications made their last appearance here; notes are on the entries
  they belong to:
  - the anchor constraint ([CLAIM-077](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-077.md));
  - the image-level caveat on the commutator bound ([CLAIM-011](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-011.md));
  - the three tiers of noncommutation ([TERM-024](../../record/terms.d/TERM-024.md));
  - the three senses of framing ([TERM-011](../../record/terms.d/TERM-011.md));
  - "not a generic consequence of repetition" ([CLAIM-068](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-068.md));
  - the relativity analogy's last form, "not a literal Lorentz geometry for
    discourse" ([CLAIM-035](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-035.md)).

  Its two transmission profiles are [CLAIM-081](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-081.md).
- **Four experiments (U23–U26).** All results below are as the transcript
  states them.
  - U23 "run it" gave E1 ([CASE-017](../../record/cases.d/CASE-017.md)). It is exact computation on
    hand-chosen synthetic matrices: order TV 0.4355; static-equal kernels
    diverging to TV 0.4475; convergence without preservation; a bound holding
    in 10,000/10,000 trials.
  - U24 "do it" gave E2 ([CASE-030](../../record/cases.d/CASE-030.md)): chains the assistant wrote itself,
    scored by content-word Jaccard.
  - U25 asked for tool calls. E3 ([CASE-020](../../record/cases.d/CASE-020.md)) is a 240-call harness that
    was only dry-run: "No model-generated observations were recorded."
  - U26: "lol you ARE a text generation action. just delegate subtasks". The
    assistant conceded but did not delegate, and wrote E4 ([CASE-032](../../record/cases.d/CASE-032.md))
    in-context.
  - The lasting lesson is that lexical overlap cannot see footing
    ([CLAIM-084](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-084.md)). The question the experiments were meant to answer is
    still open ([QUESTION-014](../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-014.md)).
  - No result reached a later draft ([CLAIM-028](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-028.md)). C6 Appendix F excluded
    the authored chains by rule, but the synthetic existence constructions
    were dropped without a reason.
- **Latents (U27).** The owner asked for higher-order latents for "the more
  abstract similarity" ([CLAIM-008](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-008.md), [TERM-032](../../record/terms.d/TERM-032.md)). A73 built a four-level
  hierarchy topped by a relational configuration, with local and global
  distances and a "pragmatic phase change" ([CLAIM-114](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-114.md), recovered).
- **Observables (U28).** The owner: "this isn't a strict hierarchy. it's more
  like a hierarchy of levels at which observables exist, and the 'objects' are
  intersections of regions of observables" ([CLAIM-042](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-042.md), [TERM-009](../../record/terms.d/TERM-009.md),
  [TERM-022](../../record/terms.d/TERM-022.md)). A75: "a more fundamental formulation". Three of its
  consequences are recovered: broadening one dimension while narrowing another
  ([CLAIM-033](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-033.md)), chains as reorganizations of constraints rather than
  accumulated error ([CLAIM-031](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-031.md)), and the concept lattice
  ([CLAIM-119](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-119.md)). The record held Ganter and Wille ([LIT-344](../../record/literature.d/LIT-344.md)) unread.
- **Sheaves (U29).** The owner: "I think the nucleation record has some useful
  sheaf contextuality resources we could connect to". A78: "I couldn't reopen
  its live index in this pass, so I verified these papers against their
  primary publication records rather than claiming to have rechecked every
  Nucleation annotation." So the second pointer to this record, like the
  first, reached the readings only in part.
  - The record held [LIT-016](../../record/literature.d/LIT-016.md) with [THEORY-012](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-012.md), [LIT-278](../../record/literature.d/LIT-278.md) (*Contextuality,
    Cohomology and Paradox*), [LIT-277](../../record/literature.d/LIT-277.md), and the contextual fraction ([LIT-265](../../record/literature.d/LIT-265.md),
    unread).
  - What A78 built: the object as a compatible family of local sections
    ([TERM-002](../../record/terms.d/TERM-002.md), [CLAIM-038](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-038.md)). It gave the parity example
    ([CASE-035](../../record/cases.d/CASE-035.md)), and this is where the switch from [CASE-008](../../record/cases.d/CASE-008.md)
    happened. It also gave the thesis "Translation may preserve local meanings
    while changing the global structure of meaning" ([CLAIM-105](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-105.md)), with
    D_sheaf, the form of the manuscript's L_obs ([CLAIM-005](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-005.md)), and Δ_CF.
  - Its proposed order (cover, local sections, empirical model, transport,
    composition) is the manuscript's §§3–8.

**What the codes show.** The owner moved the argument twice in this stretch
with a single line each, at U28 and U29, and both moves reached the

## A review of the record's new views, relayed by the owner: what the record already held, what it files, and what it leaves to the owner

*2026-10-09 23:05:42*

**Source.** On 2026-10-09 the owner relayed a review of the record. It reads
the generated revision, argument-line, dialectic, theory-line and lineage
views, and it says what the next manuscript revision should change. This
entry checks each of its points against the record before anything is filed.

## Points the record already held

The review reads the record accurately. Most of what it asks for is already
filed, and it asks for the manuscript to catch up:

- **Admissible transport with a nondegeneracy condition.** The collapse
  objection and its remedy are [CLAIM-011](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-011.md) (Active, granted). The definition
  that excludes collapse is [CLAIM-077](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-077.md) (Proposed). The review asks that
  the definition carry both halves: which distinctions must stay apart, and
  how held-out tasks show they did. [CLAIM-077](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-077.md) states only the first, and the
  second is [CLAIM-011](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-011.md)'s remedy. The two are joined in the manuscript or not at
  all. That is the owner's call, so neither claim is changed here.
- **The two open problems** are [CLAIM-125](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-125.md) as filed. **Stitching as a
  test** is [CLAIM-126](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-126.md) as filed.
- **The four corrections** are already granted claims, each with the fix it
  asks for: [CLAIM-072](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-072.md) (Saussure), [CLAIM-094](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-094.md) (Baez–Fong), [CLAIM-066](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-066.md)
  (iterated learning) and [CLAIM-053](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-053.md) (necessity). For [CLAIM-053](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-053.md) the record
  says where the missing argument is: A12's asymmetry ([CLAIM-061](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-061.md)) and A24's
  compensation hypothesis ([CLAIM-091](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-091.md)).
- **Separating preservation theorems, decision comparisons and empirical
  conjectures.** In the record this is the difference between `role` and
  `status` on a claim, together with Propositions 1 and 2 being Active
  ([CLAIM-121](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-121.md), [CLAIM-070](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-070.md)). Laying out the manuscript that way is the
  owner's work.

## What is filed

- **[CLAIM-127](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-127.md)** (Proposed thesis): a framing intervention indexes the empirical model,
  e_C^do(a), and is not a context in its cover. The record had the
  distinction only in words ([TERM-018](../../record/terms.d/TERM-018.md) against [TERM-030](../../record/terms.d/TERM-030.md)). The review
  mentions "our recent Pearl-inspired refinement", and no entry in the record
  carries one. The claim does not rest on it.
- **[QUESTION-026](../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-026.md)**: whether DisCoCat's composition constrains transport. The
  review did not mention that the two clusters already meet in Semantic
  Unification ([LIT-841](../../record/literature.d/LIT-841.md)). The question's sharp edge comes from the
  manuscript: what DisCoCat composes is the proposition, which [CLAIM-061](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-061.md) says
  is not enough.

## What is not filed, and why

- **The principle "preserve the type of epistemic relationship".** Not filed
  as a DP. The review presents it as extending a principle, "Conceptual
  Revision Requires Formal Reconciliation", but the record holds no such
  principle. A DP is added on the second re-derivation of the same reasoning,
  and this is the first. Most of the six types already exist as relations or
  statuses ([ADR-032](../../record/decisions.d/ADR-032.md)):
  - revision is a version or `supersedes`;
  - refutation is `objects_to` or `undercuts`, then Rejected;
  - derivation is `rests_on`, or an ARG.

  The other three have no type of their own:
  - **Qualification** is written in prose. [CLAIM-125](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-125.md) supersedes [CLAIM-100](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-100.md)
    "narrowed", and [CLAIM-011](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-011.md) objects to [CLAIM-117](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-117.md) "as stated, not to its
    truth".
  - **Operationalization** and **empirical test** have no relation at all.

  [ADR-032](../../record/decisions.d/ADR-032.md) rejected "borrowing a full argumentation ontology". Adding
  relations for these three would be a new decision, and it belongs to the
  owner.
- **The automated check the review proposes already runs, untyped.** Luria
  warns on every citation of a document that is not in force, a `rests_on`
  into a Rejected claim included. The warning is silenced only by an
  `inactive-ok` annotation that states a reason. It is a warning and not an
  error, and it does not tell a premise from a passing mention. The review's
  second check would catch a term whose type changes while equations still
  use it the old way. Nothing does that, because the record holds no
  equations as structured objects.
- **The second-order research question.** The review asks whether the
  preservation and validity of scientific claims can be formalized as their
  conceptual dependencies change. It is not filed. It would need a line of
  its own, and `lines` is closed by decision. It is also a question about the
  record, not about pragmatic transport.

*Correction, 2026-10-10: three points above were written without the two
owner turns that came before the review, U40 and U41 (2026-10-09 07:23–07:35),
which are now reconstructed. The "recent Pearl-inspired refinement" exists: it
is the owner's U41 ("this feels to me like an opportunity for Judea Pearl's

says so. "Conceptual Revision Requires Formal Reconciliation" was drafted at

were filed the same morning in [#99](https://github.com/dmarx/nucleation/issues/99) (08:01) and [#100](https://github.com/dmarx/nucleation/issues/100) (08:33).*

## Session of 2026-10-10, the record's replies: the audit's 34 objections refuted, reconciled, repaired or conceded

*2026-10-10 16:01:48*

*Not a reconstruction of the exchange: a working session on the record's own
argument, in reply to the 34 objections filed earlier the same day from the
audit of the line (PR [#121](https://github.com/dmarx/nucleation/issues/121)).*

**What was asked.** The owner asked to "attempt to address/refute/resolve/reconcile
anticipated objections". Each objection was given one disposition: refuted,
reconciled, repaired or conceded. A planner read the 34 and every thesis they
target, then three writers filed the replies, re-deriving each mathematical
step. Every reply says whether it is decisive and checkable or a proposal.

**Conventions kept.** A counter that was right about its target as written went
Active, with a history note naming the repair ([ADR-032](../../record/decisions.d/ADR-032.md): "a conceded one went
Active"; precedent [CLAIM-040](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-040.md)). Rejected was kept for the two objections found
mistaken. [CLAIM-115](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-115.md) and [CLAIM-139](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-139.md) were not edited at all: their repairs are
filed beside them as proposals. Manuscript-quoted claims were changed only in
the record's own fields (a `defeated_if`, a relation or a note), and each
history note quotes the replaced wording. [CLAIM-236](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-236.md) keeps its role, `granted`, and
went Rejected at version 2: the concession was withdrawn.

**Refuted (2).**
- [CLAIM-236](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-236.md): [CLAIM-111](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-111.md)'s criterion compares each language's own listener posterior,
  so it needs no correspondence of alternative sets ([CLAIM-214](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-214.md), Active).
- [CLAIM-246](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-246.md): fidelity belongs to a transport and sharing a kind does not, so an
  independent utterance of the same kind has no fidelity to the source ([CLAIM-210](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-210.md),
  Active).

**Reconciled (7).**
- The holistic fidelity judgement as a default weighting over the profile ([CLAIM-240](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-240.md);
  [CLAIM-244](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-244.md) stays open).
- Competent uptake as the standard of a communicative kind, which answers [CLAIM-206](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-206.md)'s
  dilemma and supplies the argument [CLAIM-247](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-247.md) found missing ([CLAIM-217](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-217.md); [TERM-040](../../record/terms.d/TERM-040.md) version 2).
- Survival against certifiable survival: whether a distinction survived is fixed
  by the receiver, whether it can be shown to have survived by the analyst's
  probes. This gives the `complements` link between [CLAIM-115](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-115.md) and [CLAIM-139](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-139.md) a
  content reason ([CLAIM-223](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-223.md), for [CLAIM-211](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-211.md)).

  helps a restricted receiver ([CLAIM-199](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-199.md), for [CLAIM-225](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-225.md)).

## Session of 2026-10-11: the self as a multi-agent system, and synchronization through temporal discounting, mindfulness and flow

*2026-10-11 00:33:19*

<!-- inactive-ok-file: THEORY-067 THEORY-043 THEORY-051 THEORY-064 THEORY-070 THEORY-069 CLAIM-027 — Proposed; the readings and thesis the session connected, cited as standing where they stand -->
<!-- inactive-ok-file: LIT-914 LIT-912 LIT-910 LIT-906 LIT-916 — Unavailable, unread; registered this session -->

**The owner's prompt.** The owner opened with "self as a multi agent system".
Asked what to do with it, they answered: "connect these ideas to
synchronization through temporal discounting, mindfulness, and flow state".
Nothing filed in this session is the owner's beyond those two lines.
Everything below was proposed by the assistant, and the owner has endorsed
none of it.

**What the record already held.** Plenty on the self as many: Minsky,
Selfridge, Dennett and Levin, with [THEORY-043](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-043.md) on composition. Ainslie's
interests are [THEORY-067](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-067.md), against Bratman's [THEORY-076](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-076.md). On mindfulness,
ACT's self as context ([THEORY-051](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-051.md)), and [THEORY-064](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-064.md) on how a self-model
becomes opaque. Effort cost is [THEORY-070](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-070.md), and coordination dynamics is
[THEORY-069](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-069.md). Nothing on flow at all, and nothing joining any of these to
another. The one entry that had joined will to synchrony, [CLAIM-012](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-012.md) (will as
a higher-order attractor), was superseded on 2026-10-05.

**What moved.**

- **The question.** [QUESTION-034](../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-034.md) refines [QUESTION-015](../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-015.md) for the
  population case. Is acting as one a matter of enforcement among the
  interests, a change in which interest may act, or agreement among them?
- **The term.** [TERM-050](../../record/terms.d/TERM-050.md), intrapersonal synchronization: no regime's
  valuation of the course crosses within the horizon. It is defined without
  dynamics on purpose.
- **Discounting is the source.** On Ainslie's account the population is
  produced by crossing curves ([CLAIM-169](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-169.md)). Where nothing crosses there
  is one interest. Multiplicity that differs in method rather than delay
  (IFS, [THEORY-062](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-062.md)) is set aside as a second axis.
- **Flow is agreement** ([CLAIM-162](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-162.md)). The autotelic condition makes the
  short-delay and long-delay rewards the same reward, so nothing is
  overridden and nothing costs effort. The illustration is [CASE-051](../../record/cases.d/CASE-051.md), a
  third afternoon for the reluctant writer. Dietrich's hypofrontality is
  named as the rival, in which one system yields rather than all agreeing.
- **Mindfulness is suspension** ([CLAIM-156](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-156.md)). It leaves the crossing
  and breaks the step from dominance to control, which makes it a second
  individual-scale instance of [CLAIM-027](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-027.md). The one direct study, as
  summarised ([LIT-906](../../record/literature.d/LIT-906.md)), points the other way, and the claim says so.
- **The objection** ([CLAIM-163](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-163.md)): synchronization without coupling, an
  order parameter or transitions is a name, not a mechanism. It is left
  open, with the parts that would answer it listed.

**What was learned that the claims cannot say.** The three routes in the
prompt come apart cleanly only once each is described by what it does to
the crossing: outweigh it, remove it, or leave it and change who may act.
Without that, "mindfulness and flow both synchronize the self" would have
filed two different mechanisms as one. Whether the word "synchronization"
is earned turned out to be the open question the owner's framing raises,
and it is filed as an objection rather than assumed.

**Not done.** None of the flow or mindfulness literature was read; five
works are registered unread (see the curation entry of the same date).
Neither [THEORY-067](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-067.md) nor the new claims connect to Bratman's rival
([THEORY-076](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-076.md)). Whether resolute intention is a fourth route, or the
bargaining route under another name, is left for a second occasion.

## Session of 2026-10-11, continued: extended self and entrainment; storage as a variant of the tree in the woods; a joke over a life

*2026-10-11 00:55:26*

**The owner's prompts**, in order and verbatim:

1. "connect extended self to entrainment"
2. "information storage as a variant of tree-in-woods case. data is written
   with a potential future receiver in mind. even if the data is never
   read, its intended meaning was fixed by the write"
3. "CASE: the meaning of a specific joke -- e.g. scene from a film v show
   -- changing for an individual as they mature from child reader to adult
   reader."

The second prompt's claim is the owner's. It is filed as [CLAIM-160](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-160.md),
Proposed, with their words quoted. Everything else below was proposed by
the assistant and is unendorsed.

**What the record already held.** The extended-mind debate, read in full:
Clark & Chalmers ([LIT-097](../../record/literature.d/LIT-097.md)), Adams & Aizawa ([LIT-438](../../record/literature.d/LIT-438.md), [LIT-455](../../record/literature.d/LIT-455.md)), Rupert,
Chalmers 2019, Levin, and participatory sense-making. Coordination dynamics
was there as [THEORY-069](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-069.md). No entry said entrainment bounds a self. On the
pragmatic-transport side, no claim said whether meaning is fixed at
production or at reception. [CLAIM-151](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-151.md) says "expected uptake", [CLAIM-115](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-115.md) a
"receiving system", and [CLAIM-140](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-140.md) records that the line's criterion moved
from receiver to analyst without argument. The record held no tree in the
woods, and no case of storage or writing.

**What moved.**

- **Extended self and entrainment** (distributed-agency, [CLAIM-172](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-172.md)).
  Mutual entrainment individuates a coupled system by its collective
  variable. That sidesteps the coupling-constitution objection, which
  forbids inferring parthood in the organism. It excludes one-way drive
  (the nerve and the muscle, the metronome). The objection [CLAIM-165](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-165.md),
  two dancers in phase who stay two selves, is open: the claim bounds a
  system and has no criterion for when that system is a self.
- **Two routes to extension.** Entrainment is synchronic. Otto's notebook
  does not keep time with Otto. It is coupled by a write and a later read.
  So the owner's two prompts meet: the storage variant ([CASE-043](../../record/cases.d/CASE-043.md)),
  with the writer as their own future reader, is the diachronic route.
- **Storage** (pragmatic-transport). The tree ([CASE-049](../../record/cases.d/CASE-049.md)) is the
  baseline with no sender. The variant adds a sender and a projected
  receiver and removes only the actual one. The owner's claim then
  separates two times: intended meaning is fixed at the write, relative to
  the writer's frame ([TERM-030](../../record/terms.d/TERM-030.md)), and fidelity is measured at each read
  ([CLAIM-115](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-115.md), [CLAIM-074](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-074.md)). This fills a gap the line had: production versus
  reception was never decided. The anticipated objection, [CLAIM-171](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-171.md),
  is that intention is just one more reading. It is open.
- **The joke** ([CASE-048](../../record/cases.d/CASE-048.md)) is filed as a test that cuts both ways. The
  dual-address joke was designed to be missed, which supports a meaning
  fixed at the write. The adult's experience that the scene became a
  different joke supports the objection. [CLAIM-074](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-074.md)'s states of adaptation
  of one interpreter is where the line already had room for it.

**Bearing on the morning's claims.** Entrainment supplies, for a person and
an external process, the coupling and order parameter that [CLAIM-163](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-163.md)
said intrapersonal "synchronization" lacks. It does not supply them for
interests over time. That objection stands.

**Not done.** No new literature. Reception theory and reader-response
criticism are not held, so [CLAIM-171](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-171.md) is stated from the record's own
materials. The *Shrek* line is named as an instance of the joke case, not
analysed.

## Session of 2026-10-11, continued: the corporate event as a synchronization mechanism

*2026-10-11 01:31:42*

**The owner's prompt**, verbatim: "CASE: a corporate event as a
synchronization mechanism for a \"corporate entity\" (i.e. a kind of a
'self')".

It came after the assistant offered, in chat and unfiled, a candidate
synthesis: that a self holds together over time as a communication
achievement among its stages. Entrainment would be a real-time channel,
storage and precommitment written messages, flow the case where no message
is needed, and mindfulness a receiver taking an impulse as a message rather
than a command. Discounting and decoding drift would be the two failure
modes. The owner did not respond to the synthesis and gave this case
instead.

**What moved.** [CASE-050](../../record/cases.d/CASE-050.md) was filed in distributed-agency. It is the first case
where every route from the session runs at once, at firm scale:
entrainment by co-presence (with [THEORY-126](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-126.md)'s collective emotion as the
nearest reading), a write for later readers ([CLAIM-160](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-160.md)), and incentive
realignment ([CLAIM-162](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-162.md)'s condition). It adds one thing the individual
cases lacked, cadence: drift resumes between events, so the event works as
periodic forcing. The case illustrates both [CLAIM-172](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-172.md) and its open
objection [CLAIM-165](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-165.md), because whether the firm is a self is exactly
what that objection disputes.

**Not done.** The synthesis is not filed as a claim. If it is, this case
belongs among its illustrations.

## Session of 2026-10-11, continued: vocabulary before "self", and the dancers objection fails

*2026-10-11 02:12:38*

**The owner's prompts**, verbatim:

1. "maybe it would be helpful if we came up with (or adopted) our own
   language, characterize what that thing is, and then ask if it's
   appropriate to call that thing a \"self\""
2. "elaborate on \"coordinative structure\" and \"holon\""
3. "I haven't read the dancers objection, but my immediate thoughts are
   that the objection fails and that by the extended mind thesis... here,
   bing more concrete: consider a pair of social dancers, like a a lindy
   hop or tango or salsa dancing couple. under extended mind thesis, I'd
   argue that the pair, while dancing together, comprises a combined form
   that merits some privileged nomenclature of some kind"

**The method (prompt 1).** Name the thing neutrally, characterize it, and
only then ask whether "self" fits. This is [ADR-024](../../record/decisions.d/ADR-024.md)'s discipline applied to
the session's own drift. In chat the assistant proposed a vocabulary, none
of it adopted:

- **The thing:** "consort", a collection of members or stages that differ
  in value, timing or decoding and act as one only while a maintained
  coordination holds them.
- **Routes:** entrainment, inscription, alignment, suspension and
  bargaining.
- **Failures:** reversal, misreading and drift.
- **Dimensions:** span, horizon, coherence and cadence.

**The adopted alternatives (prompt 2).** In chat, from general knowledge
(neither source is held):

- **Coordinative structure** (Bernstein; Turvey; Kugler, Kelso & Turvey
  1980). A task-specific, soft-assembled unit with no controller, whose
  signature is *reciprocal compensation under perturbation* (Kelso et al.
  1984, the jaw-perturbation studies). It fits assembly, drift and the
  absence of a governor, and it supplies a sharper membership test. But it
  is synchronic, has no place for inscription, and takes its goal from
  outside.
- **Holon** (Koestler 1967, after Simon 1962). A whole to its parts and a
  part to its whole, with self-assertive and integrative tendencies. It
  fits nesting and names the dancers' tension. But it names a position,
  not an achievement, and it would bring back the permissiveness
  objection ([CLAIM-010](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-010.md)).

The suggestion was to take the compensation test from the first and the
two tendencies from the second, and keep a word for the maintained thing.
Not decided.

**What moved (prompt 3).** The owner's reply is filed as [CLAIM-175](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-175.md),
and the couple as [CASE-046](../../record/cases.d/CASE-046.md). On rereading, the assistant found the
objection had misused its source. [LIT-571](../../record/literature.d/LIT-571.md) requires that the dancers stay
autonomous, and it also calls the interaction "an emergent and autonomous
process". Clark & Chalmers endorse socially extended cognition in an
interdependent couple. So [CLAIM-165](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-165.md)'s version 1 failed. Version 2
keeps only the subject sense of "self", and leaves open whether that is the
sense worth asking about. [CLAIM-172](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-172.md)'s title said "extended self",
ahead of the owner's method. Version 2 says "combined form".

**Still to decide.** The name for the combined form, and which sense of
"self" (subject, as in [ADR-024](../../record/decisions.d/ADR-024.md), or dispositional, as in Clark & Chalmers)
the follow-up question uses.

## Session of 2026-10-11, continued: a threshold criterion for one system, from Mathematics of Meaning

*2026-10-11 03:20:13*

**The owner's prompts**, verbatim:

1. "I think there might be some useful ideas regarding system boundary
   identification in there somewhere" (of dmarx/mathematics-of-meaning)
2. "register MoM as a remote and then dual file anything we need from there
   on nucleation directly"
3. "open a PR on nucleation and file the entries relevant to the threshold
   criterion stuff"

**What the survey found.** MoM's record has no single boundary criterion. Its
own [MOM-CLM-170](https://github.com/dmarx/mathematics-of-meaning/blob/main/record/claims.d/CLM-170.md) says the corpus's five candidates "terminate in a shrug".
But it has a priced one in three parts:
- **the gap picks the object** ([MOM-CLM-144](https://github.com/dmarx/mathematics-of-meaning/blob/main/record/claims.d/CLM-144.md));
- **the Occam factor says how big the gap must be** ([MOM-CLM-160](https://github.com/dmarx/mathematics-of-meaning/blob/main/record/claims.d/CLM-160.md));
- **Simon's near-decomposability says what to compare** ([MOM-LIT-018](https://github.com/dmarx/mathematics-of-meaning/blob/main/record/literature.d/LIT-018.md)).

Persistence ([MOM-CLM-153](https://github.com/dmarx/mathematics-of-meaning/blob/main/record/claims.d/CLM-153.md)) and unity by gluing ([MOM-CLM-165](https://github.com/dmarx/mathematics-of-meaning/blob/main/record/claims.d/CLM-165.md)) sit beside
them, and target-relativity ([MOM-POS-001](https://github.com/dmarx/mathematics-of-meaning/blob/main/record/positions.d/POS-001.md)) cautions all of them. These were
dual-filed under [ADR-037](../../record/decisions.d/ADR-037.md). Three were re-checked by script.

**What moved.**
- **The question.** [QUESTION-035](../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-035.md), given a code at its third appearance:
  when is a combined form one system, relative to a target?
- **The answer.** [CLAIM-157](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-157.md) joins the parts: block, threshold, unit and
  duration. It is the record's answer to the owner's "privileged
  nomenclature": the name is earned when the gap beats the cost of keeping
  it.
- **The objection.** [CLAIM-173](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-173.md), which is open. The criterion measures
  strength, not direction, so one-way drive passes, and that is the
  coupling-constitution fallacy again. The reply is to import
  entrainment's mutuality as a matrix condition. It is sketched and not
  filed, because the record's paradigm case has a lead and a follow, and
  a directional version might over-exclude it.
- **The study.** [CASE-045](../../record/cases.d/CASE-045.md) is a stipulated motion-capture design that
  would test the claim, the compensation prediction and the direction
  worry together.

**What was learned that the entries cannot say.** The criteria the record
had been collecting are not rivals. Strength, timing, goal-preservation,
persistence and gluing are separate measurements of one candidate, and the
interesting cases are where they disagree. The metronome is strong and
one-way. The notebook is diachronic, so a synchronous block test does not
see it at all. That is the first place the storage route and the
entrainment route visibly need different mathematics.

## Session of 2026-10-11, continued: one-way drive passes, and direction is architecture

*2026-10-11 04:15:56*

**The owner's prompts**, verbatim:
1. Quoting the open objection, "> a metronome driving a musician, or a nerve
   driving a muscle, passes", the owner asked: "and why shouldn't they?"
2. After the assistant's answer in chat: "yes, file them on the PR branch".

**What moved.** The assistant agreed in chat that they should pass, for
three reasons, which the owner accepted for filing as [CLAIM-167](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-167.md):
- **The objection repeated a worry already set aside.** [CLAIM-172](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-172.md) had
  set aside the coupling-constitution worry by individuating a new system,
  not parthood. Nerve and muscle form the neuromuscular system, not one
  part of the other.
- **Its intuitions were about agency, not system-hood.** [QUESTION-035](../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-035.md)
  keeps those apart.
- **The study design already treated a one-way driver as an exogenous
  input.** [CASE-045](../../record/cases.d/CASE-045.md) does this with the music's beat. Inside or input
  is a choice relative to the target.

Consequences:
- [CLAIM-173](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-173.md) went Rejected.
- [CLAIM-172](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-172.md) went to version 3. Mutual entrainment is now a sufficient
  mark of a combined form whose members are *peers*. It is not a condition
  of membership.
- The QUESTION's adequacy condition on one-way drive was reversed.
- The study's direction measurement became an architecture measurement.

**What was learned.** The direction of coupling had been doing two jobs, and
only one of them was right. It cannot decide membership, and the attempt to
make it do so would have excluded the dancing couple with its lead and
follow. It does decide the *architecture*: peers or hierarchy, driver and
driven. That is what the agency question will need next. "Who drives?" is
part of whether, and where, there is an agent. The assistant's own
objection had smuggled an agency intuition into a question that was
written to exclude it. That is the same drift [ADR-024](../../record/decisions.d/ADR-024.md) was made to stop.

## Session of 2026-10-11, continued: the agency question as drive profiles, and drive that changes and comes from below

*2026-10-11 05:31:57*

**The owner's prompts**, verbatim:
1. "let's take up the agency question. I think it's probably worth
   differentiating between systems where "who drives?" has an answer wrt a
   particularly level of description or not. I think there's is probably a
   spectrum/gradient/distribution of kinds here. for two level systems, we
   have systems that experience fully top-down causation, systems where
   there is bidirectional causation, systems where there driving "will" is
   emergent from the system as a whole, etc."
2. "I think it's probably also worth noting that "who drives" isn't a
   constant. Considering myself as a multi-level agent, part of my
   composition is my microbiome. my understanding is that my microbiome can
   impact things like my affect and level of hunger, so that lower level
   collective is capable of influencing my higher level behavior and even
   phenomenological experience."

**What moved.**
- **The question.** [QUESTION-033](../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-033.md).
- **The owner's two theses.** [CLAIM-158](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-158.md), the spectrum. [CLAIM-166](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-166.md),
  non-constancy and the microbiome, with [CASE-047](../../record/cases.d/CASE-047.md).
- **The vocabulary.** [TERM-051](../../record/terms.d/TERM-051.md), "drive profile", whose name is provisional
  and was not chosen by the owner. It has two axes. Within a level: hierarchy,
  peers or diffuse. Across levels: aggregate, top-down, bidirectional or
  emergent. It is time-indexed.
- **The grounding was already in the record.** [LIT-025](../../record/literature.d/LIT-025.md)'s information
  decomposition splits a macro-variable's synergy into downward causation
  and causal decoupling, and [THEORY-133](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-133.md) makes a higher level the cause
  system by system. The owner's kinds are regions of that space.
- **A refinement offered to the owner.** "Fully top-down" can only mean that
  the parts' detail is irrelevant given the higher level, not that the
  higher level drives without them.
- **The assistant's claim.** [CLAIM-159](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-159.md) holds that the will line's three
  accounts sit in different cells: Ainslie aggregate or emergent, the
  expected value of control top-down, and will-organization as what
  governs the drive profile's *changes*. That last gives the owner's
  non-constancy a home in the will paper.
- **The evidence for the microbiome.** Two reviews were read for it
  (curation entry of the same date). The routes are real and the effects
  are causal in rodents. The human evidence is modest: small effects on
  subjective stress, and clean nulls. The claim stays Proposed on the
  evidence, not on the concept.
- **The dancing-couple study** gains a drive-profile measurement:
  whether "the dance leads".

**What was learned.** The microbiome example adds two things the
two-level picture lacked. The lower level can be a *collective of other
organisms*, with its own diffuse drive and a disputable membership: the
holobiont question meets the threshold criterion. And drive from below can
reach *experience*, by way of interoception, which connects this line to
the felt-affect theories ([THEORY-045](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-045.md)).

## Session of 2026-10-11, continued: agents as the jurisdiction of a will-organization

*2026-10-11 06:03:12*

**The owner's prompts**, verbatim:
1. "don't feel constrained to use my words here, we're collaborating on
   this. My suspicion is that what we consider an "agent" is probably at
   least partly a function of not only a given context but also a level of
   description. the agents in a given system are how we factorize that
   system relative to a given level of description. I also wonder/suspect
   if agents are identified by their will (and/or will-organization)"
2. "yes, jurisdiction of a will-organization — file it all"

The first prompt changes the filing practice. The owner asked to be treated
as a collaborator, so the owner's theses may be stated in the record's
words, with the verbatim prompt kept in the entry. [CLAIM-170](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-170.md) is the
first claim filed this way.

**What the assistant contributed in chat, and the owner accepted.**
- **Agree on factorization, with a guard.** Relative to a level and a
  target, but not arbitrary: a factorization can be wrong given its target,
  or the permissiveness objection returns.
- **Will-organization, not operative will.** Agents identified by operative
  will would flicker with the drive profile. The microbiome would become an
  agent whenever it drove hunger. A will-organization is maintained, so an
  agent is its *jurisdiction*: the regimes whose efficacy it governs
  ([TERM-047](../../record/terms.d/TERM-047.md)).
- **The reversal, named.** This inverts the will paper's order of
  explanation. The paper supposed its agent ([CLAIM-080](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-080.md)) to escape [CLAIM-010](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-010.md).
  The objection is filed as [CLAIM-168](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-168.md).

**What moved.**
- [QUESTION-032](../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-032.md).
- [TERM-047](../../record/terms.d/TERM-047.md), kept distinct from [TERM-017](../../record/terms.d/TERM-017.md)'s jurisdiction.
- The owner's thesis, [CLAIM-170](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-170.md).
- The assistant's admission test, [CLAIM-174](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-174.md), with three tests: system,
  description and adaptation.
- The circularity counter, [CLAIM-168](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-168.md), open.
- The thermostat coded at its second appearance, [CASE-044](../../record/cases.d/CASE-044.md).
- Two readings (curation entry of the same date).

**What was learned.** The strongest support came from where it was not
looked for. Kenton et al. find that the thermostat is not an agent but the
thermostat with its creation process is, and that a training process, not
the trained policy, is the agent. That locates the agent where the governing
process is, even when the governor sits outside the device. That is agent
individuated by jurisdiction, reached independently. Kenton et al. also
state the relativity: decision and utility labels are "frame-dependent". The
open question is now precise: whether the several self-consistent
factorizations the test allows are the level-relativity the owner predicted
or an indeterminacy.

named the others.

- [ADR-032](../../record/decisions.d/ADR-032.md)'s lesson from the will exchange: identity, not structure, is what

  turns up.
- The workbench reconstructions of the translation exchange. They keep

  and the mnemonist's cautionary half ([LU-ADR-011](https://github.com/dmarx/luria/blob/main/record/decisions.d/ADR-011.md)).

**The reading.** It is the assistant's reading of the title, not the
owner's statement of it. Read through the title, the pieces form one

1. Argument developed with collaborators who keep no memory is
   supersaturated. It fails at identity, not at structure ([CLAIM-177](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-177.md)).
2. Codes are nucleation sites, and recurrence is the threshold
   ([CLAIM-176](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-176.md)). That this manuscript's own idea recurred across
   separate sessions before anyone named it is an instance.
3. Agent filing removes the disparity that design-rationale systems were

4. The manuscript is a view over the argument, not its only copy
   ([CLAIM-178](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-178.md)). Views read back become instruments ([CLAIM-183](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-183.md)).
5. The objection to answer is that the lattice belongs to the seed: the
   record shapes what it claims only to stabilize ([CLAIM-181](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-181.md)).

**Filed.** A line, `nucleating-argument`, and the `works` term were added,
with one question and six claims, all Proposed. The A125 flourish is now
coded as the frame of [CLAIM-183](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-183.md), because its second occurrence is this
session.

**Open.** Whether this is the argument the owner meant. The owner has not

been confirmed.

**Later the same session: the crystal analogy corrected.** The owner
questioned "a crystal takes the shape of its seed", expecting the shape to
be governed largely by chaos. Neither picture was quite right. A seed
templates the lattice (structure, orientation, polymorph). The habit is set
by growth conditions: faceted and seed-independent near equilibrium,
branching and sensitive to fluctuations far from it. [CLAIM-181](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-181.md) was
narrowed to match: the record fixes the argument's grammar, not its shape.
The correction suggested a further claim, filed at the owner's request
before any second occurrence: drift tracks the pace of the exchange, and
the record stabilizes partly by slowing growth ([CLAIM-186](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-186.md)).

**Later the same session: the threshold reframed.** After the readings of
Ostwald ([NOTE-709](../../record/notes.d/NOTE-709.md)) and Vekilov ([NOTE-708](../../record/notes.d/NOTE-708.md)) showed that no
physical nucleation threshold is a count, the owner proposed "reframing the
nucleation threshold as anything that triggers persistence. Persistent
structures that are available to serve as anchors is what permits more
complex structure to evolve on top of it." Filed as the owner's claim,
[CLAIM-185](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-185.md). [CLAIM-176](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-176.md) went to version 2: recurrence is now the
trigger of persistence this record is built around, not the threshold
itself. The readings fit the reframing better than the count. Vekilov
defines a nucleus by even odds of growth and decay, and Ostwald's seeds act
only while they persist.

**Consequences of the reframing.** Asked what the reframing changes, the
assistant proposed five things and the owner had all but one filed:

- [QUESTION-038](../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-038.md): what turns a persistent structure into an anchor?
- [CLAIM-182](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-182.md): storage is not anchoring, addressability is. The

- [CLAIM-186](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-186.md) went to version 2. Drift tracks new material against
  anchoring, not pace alone.
- Notes on [CLAIM-178](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-178.md) (drafts lose material silently because nothing
  rests on their claims), [CLAIM-181](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-181.md) (the grammar decides what can
  anchor) and [CLAIM-179](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-179.md) (flooding as unused anchors).

A claim on layering, that how deep structure can grow is bounded by how
stable the anchors beneath it are, was held back until it turns up again.
A luria report of codes with no inbound references was suggested as a
luria design question and not filed here.

**Later the same session: retrieval by content.** The owner connected

assistant read Hebb's postulate as a graded persistence trigger, and SDM's
critical distance as a model of drift. A restatement within the distance

## Session of 2026-10-11, continued: the uses: half of ADR-038 becomes configuration

*2026-10-11 09:00:00*

**The owner's prompts**, verbatim. First: "file the luria lint report
upstream. I'm wondering if there's a way we can generalize this to be
general purpose config declaration. it's possible it might even already be
a supported feature and the change we need is just in the project
luria.toml rather than somethign upstream. maybe." Then, mid-answer: "with
the "uses:" relation, isn't this a "pushdown" from the field to the
prose?" Then: "go ahead with all four, explain: cited".

**What was found.** The owner was right that half the check already
existed. Luria's `explain:` key on a reference field is pushdown: with
`explain: cited`, every code in the field must be cited in the body. Its
converse is pushup: `[[uses::TERM-…]]` written in prose is expanded by
`luria link --fix` into a citation and added to the field. Neither is a
new lint check, and nucleation needed one line in `luria.yaml`. The half
that is not there is phrase detection, a TERM's title used in an entry
that neither cites nor lists it. No field exists to declare that against,
so it stays upstream as dmarx/luria#370, narrowed by a comment there.

**What firing it found.** The report gave 70 rows, against the 60 my own
count had predicted. My count was a grep for codes in the body. The
report counts what luria treats as a citation, and the extra ten were not
traced one by one. Each row was read. Most took a
`[[uses::…]]` after the first eligible use, outside quotations, headings,
italic titles and formulas. Rows whose term is named only inside a quoted
source, or applied without being named, or which point at a TERM since
superseded, took a `ref::uses-file:` line saying which. Superseded TERMs
are kept in `uses:`, because the claim was stated in the definition
current when it was written. The fix was not mechanical at the edges.
Three citations first landed inside formulas or split a phrase, and two
were moved twice before reading cleanly.

**Then:** "yes, open a new PR, accept the two new adrs, and I'll defer too
you on the nae question." Both ADRs are Active, and the acknowledgements
that existed only because [ADR-037](../../record/decisions.d/ADR-037.md) was Proposed are removed. The name
"drive profile" is kept and argued for in [TERM-051](../../record/terms.d/TERM-051.md) version 2. The rejected
alternatives each collided with a word the record already uses for
something else: "architecture" is the within-level axis, and "regime" is
the will paper's action-generating regime. The work went to a new branch
because [#123](https://github.com/dmarx/nucleation/issues/123) had merged before it was pushed. The merge had turned the
temporary codes into numbers, so every code this change wrote was mapped
to its number.

## Session of 2026-10-11, evening: stability theory and the persistence claim

*2026-10-11 21:43:08*

*Continues the session recorded in workbench 2026/10/11/075607, after
PR 122 merged.*

**What moved.** Asked about stability theory, the assistant surveyed the
record (curation 2026/10/11/214307) and proposed four works and one
reading. The owner had them filed.

- **Persistence is relative to a constraint set.** Read against [THEORY-134](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-134.md),
  the persistence claim ([CLAIM-185](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-185.md)) has a second input it did not name.
  Persisting means staying within a constraint set fixed independently of
  the dynamics, and the theory does not supply that set. For an argument,
  the set is what counts as the same claim persisting, and the record's
  codes, versions and supersession rules fix it. That joins [CLAIM-185](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-185.md) to the
  counter [CLAIM-181](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-181.md): the grammar is the constraint set. [THEORY-134](../../record/theory.d/THEORY-134.md)'s split
  between viability and stability also gives a sharper statement of drift.
  A thesis that keeps coming back in some form is stable but not viable
  unless it stays the same claim.
- **Settling does not rule out bursts.** Generalized stability theory says a
  system stable in every mode can still amplify a disturbance for a while,
  when its operator is non-normal. Claims resting on claims are directed
  coupling, a standard source of non-normality. A note on [CLAIM-186](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-186.md) says
  that drift should be measured in the short run after a disturbance, not
  only on average.
- **A size limit.** May's threshold, s√(nC) < 1, gives flooding ([CLAIM-179](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-179.md))
  a second possible cost: past a size and connectance, a record might stop
  settling. Whether a structured record escapes the bound is the open part.

**What was not done.** No claim was filed for the constraint-set point; it
went in as notes on [CLAIM-185](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-185.md) and [CLAIM-181](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-181.md). The gaps listed in the
curation entry, from Lyapunov to Keizer & Fox, were noted and not filled.

## Session of 2026-10-12: MOM-CLM-088 and the overlap a divided self needs

*2026-10-12 02:01:01*

**The owner's prompts**, verbatim: "hey take a look at
https://github.com/dmarx/mathematics-of-meaning/blob/main/record/claims.d/CLM-088.md",
then "yes, file it all on a new branch and PR".

**What the reading found.** [MOM-CLM-088](https://github.com/dmarx/mathematics-of-meaning/blob/main/record/claims.d/CLM-088.md)'s point is that "tall" for people
and for trees cannot fail to glue, because the contexts do not overlap.
The record already had the general point, and none of its own gluing
claims made the mistake: [CLAIM-143](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-143.md), [CLAIM-131](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-131.md), [CLAIM-144](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-144.md) and [CASE-039](../../record/cases.d/CASE-039.md) all
separate disagreement from obstruction. So the value was not a
correction. It was a consequence for the will-organization line.

**The consequence.** Ainslie's interests take turns over time. If their
windows do not overlap, they glue, and a reversal of preference is not a
division of the self. Division needs a choice both interests bear on at
once, and on Ainslie's account the overlap is made by recursive
self-prediction. That gives [CLAIM-163](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-163.md)'s list of missing parts its first
item, a coupling, together with where it acts. The order parameter and
the transitions are still missing, so the objection stays open, answered
in part. Memory plays the same part for the film joke in [CASE-048](../../record/cases.d/CASE-048.md).

**What to watch.** Both new claims leave the cover unstated: which
contexts of choice count, and how finely. That is the piece [MOM-CLM-088](https://github.com/dmarx/mathematics-of-meaning/blob/main/record/claims.d/CLM-088.md) says
decides everything, and it is open here as in MOM. A claim that says a
self "fails to glue" should be asked for its overlap first.

**Then**: "if it's interesting and defensible, port it over from MoM to
nucleation". This is about §11.5, identity as a global section. As written it
fails, for the reason this branch filed [CLAIM-197](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-197.md). The interesting part
was that restating it on overlaps turned it into something sociology already
documents. boyd's collapsed contexts are overlaps made by a medium.
Audience segregation keeps a cover disjoint. A scripted wedding is a
managed overlap. The sheaf picture adds where conflict can be, and so where
segregation strategies should aim.

Two of the three obvious sources could not be read lawfully, Goffman (1959)
and Marwick & boyd (2011). boyd's dissertation is under a Creative Commons
licence and was read in the sections that matter. The Carmichael case is
therefore stipulated, not documented. The "self" in this claim is the self
as presented across audiences, which [TERM-045](../../record/terms.d/TERM-045.md) does not list. That is a gap
to fill if the sense turns up again.

A trap: I wrote this NOTE's page numbers and licence from memory of the
text, and both were wrong (five pages, and BY-NC-SA for BY-NC-ND).
A script mapping each quotation to the PDF's printed page numbers caught
the pages. Reading the licence appendix caught the licence.

**Then**: "add the presented-self sense to [TERM-045](../../record/terms.d/TERM-045.md)". It is sense 7,
numbered last so that 1–6 keep their numbers. It is defined as
audience-relative and synchronic, which separates it from persisting (3)
and narrative (4), the two it is easiest to confuse with. [CLAIM-196](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-196.md)
now cites it where the claim is stated, instead of noting the gap.
[CLAIM-153](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-153.md)'s personas could also be read in this sense. Its entry still
names sense 3, and that is left for a reading of [CLAIM-153](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-153.md) rather than
changed in passing.

*2026-10-12 20:06:51*

**What started it.** PR [#121](https://github.com/dmarx/nucleation/issues/121), one round of argument on the
`pragmatic-transport` line, was cut from main on 2026-10-10. By 2026-10-12,
six later PRs ([#122](https://github.com/dmarx/nucleation/issues/122) to [#129](https://github.com/dmarx/nucleation/issues/129)) had merged. The owner asked for [#121](https://github.com/dmarx/nucleation/issues/121) to be
reconciled. After the mechanical merge, they raised a further worry: [#121](https://github.com/dmarx/nucleation/issues/121)
challenged the argument as it then stood, and the record's argument had
moved since.

**The mechanical merge.** Thirteen conflicts were resolved, all of them
additive: relation lists, directives and dated notes. Nine `uses:` entries
on six of [#121](https://github.com/dmarx/nucleation/issues/121)'s claims were brought under [ADR-038](../../record/decisions.d/ADR-038.md) (merged in [#124](https://github.com/dmarx/nucleation/issues/124) after
[#121](https://github.com/dmarx/nucleation/issues/121) was cut). Each now gives a reason. One, [TERM-043](../../record/terms.d/TERM-043.md) on [CLAIM-204](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-204.md), is
flagged for the owner.

**The discursive audit.** Three read-only audits read the merged branch:
main's new entries on the line, main's notes and edges on existing entries,
and [#121](https://github.com/dmarx/nucleation/issues/121)'s own premises. [#121](https://github.com/dmarx/nucleation/issues/121)'s premises about its own targets still hold.
Main did not version, narrow or supersede any entry [#121](https://github.com/dmarx/nucleation/issues/121) restated.

The problems come from work filed after [#121](https://github.com/dmarx/nucleation/issues/121) that never saw it.

- **Four opposed positions, left to the owner.**
  - Whose uptake fixes the act: [CLAIM-160](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-160.md) against [CLAIM-151](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-151.md) version 2 and
    [CLAIM-217](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-217.md).
  - Whether the competent-uptake standard is circular: [CLAIM-152](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-152.md) against
    [CLAIM-217](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-217.md).
  - Whether a fidelity profile prefers a frozen argument: [CLAIM-189](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-189.md) against

  - Two senses of "cover": [CASE-048](../../record/cases.d/CASE-048.md) and [CLAIM-197](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-197.md) against [CLAIM-201](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-201.md).

  ([QUESTION-014](../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-014.md), [QUESTION-005](../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-005.md), [QUESTION-023](../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-023.md)). Two round-4 questions,
  [QUESTION-050](../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-050.md) and [QUESTION-067](../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-067.md), also predate [#121](https://github.com/dmarx/nucleation/issues/121) in substance.
- **About a dozen missing links.** In each, [#121](https://github.com/dmarx/nucleation/issues/121) held the case or the
  assessment that a later entry asked for.

**What was done here.** The stale statements and missing links were
repaired with dated notes and five typed relations:

- [CLAIM-190](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-190.md) grounds [CASE-071](../../record/cases.d/CASE-071.md).

## Session of 2026-10-12: the interlocutor reads PR #121's reconciliation, filed as advice

*2026-10-12 20:35:30*

*The owner relayed an interlocutor's reading of PR [#121](https://github.com/dmarx/nucleation/issues/121) on 2026-10-12. The
reading covers the PR itself, its reconciliation comment of the same day and
the underlying claims. The owner said it is "an interlocutor's reading, file
it as advice". No share link or turn numbers were given, so it is cited here
by date.*

**The reading's diagnosis.** "The project is oscillating between three
different theories of meaning and identity without always making the
transitions explicit": a production-centred theory (intention fixes what was
meant), a relational-constitutive one (roles, norms and uptake partly fix
the act), and an operational one (what can be recovered depends on probes,
populations and tasks). "These need not be competing theories. But they have
different identity conditions, and treating their objects as interchangeable
creates much of the apparent conflict."

**The four open tensions, as the reading takes them.**
1. Whose uptake constitutes the act: different objects. Intending,
   performing and being recognized are distinct variables. Filed as the
   thesis [CLAIM-255](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-255.md), which partly answers [QUESTION-073](../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-073.md).
2. Circularity: "[CLAIM-152](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-152.md) has the stronger argument as currently
   formulated". Competent uptake is "a locally privileged criterion". This
   repeats [CLAIM-241](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-241.md)'s point, which is now noted there as a second
   occurrence. No new code.
3. Fidelity and development: "mostly reconcilable". The fidelity object of a
   developing argument is its "accountability structure". Filed as the
   thesis [CLAIM-250](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-250.md), beside [CLAIM-189](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-189.md).
4. Cover: three operations, only one of which engages gluing. Filed as the
   counter [CLAIM-251](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-251.md) to [CLAIM-201](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-201.md).

**Beyond the four.**
- The decomposition into production, social constitution, interpretation and
  operational recovery. "Recoverability does not imply constitution", and
  "constitution does not imply identifiability". Most of this is already held
  ([CLAIM-142](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-142.md), [CLAIM-135](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-135.md), [TERM-040](../../record/terms.d/TERM-040.md)). The new part is the production level,
  which [TERM-040](../../record/terms.d/TERM-040.md) has no slot for. That is noted on [TERM-040](../../record/terms.d/TERM-040.md).
- The empirical contribution. The reading favours [CLAIM-202](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-202.md) as the
  principal empirical thesis, but says its rival set lacks a strong
  contextual baseline. Filed as the counter [CLAIM-205](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-205.md). The test it calls
  distinctive, predicting an unobserved composition, is [QUESTION-074](../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-074.md).
  That question is scoped by [CLAIM-260](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-260.md)'s conditions, under which alone
  approximate transports compose.
- The tension the reading would leave open, realist against operationalist.
  Its middle position, a kind as a hypothesis of invariance with
  extrapolation to new measurement families, is filed as [CLAIM-213](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-213.md).

**Its five priorities, recorded as advice and not taken.**
1. Resolve the referent of identity first.
2. Retain target relativity, with population, competence and disagreement as
   explicit parameters.
3. Separate preservation from evaluation.
4. Formalize the measurement scenario before invoking sheaf theory.
5. Make structural generalization the empirical target.

Its closing reformulation of the line's question is quoted in [CLAIM-213](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-213.md):
"Ask which relations are invariant, under which transformations, relative
to which observational capacities—and which of those invariances support
predictions beyond the observations that established them."

**What the record does with it.** It takes nothing. The six new entries are
Proposed or Open and attributed to the interlocutor. The four tensions and
PR [#121](https://github.com/dmarx/nucleation/issues/121)'s decisions remain the owner's. Notes on [CLAIM-160](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-160.md), [CLAIM-217](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-217.md),
[CLAIM-152](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-152.md), [CLAIM-189](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-189.md), [CLAIM-252](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-252.md), [CASE-048](../../record/cases.d/CASE-048.md), [CLAIM-197](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-197.md), [CLAIM-202](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-202.md),
[TERM-040](../../record/terms.d/TERM-040.md) and [CLAIM-241](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-241.md) record what the reading recommends for each.

**Where the reading meets what is already held.** The assistant's reply to
the owner found three points already filed:
- [CLAIM-241](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-241.md) already says uptake is "a defeasible standard … not the
  criterion".
- [CLAIM-189](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-189.md)'s own thesis is traceability, which the reading's
  "accountability structure" fills out.
- [CLAIM-142](../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-142.md) already requires probes evaluated on held-out cases.

What is new is the production-level referent, the strong contextual
baseline, the composition test, and extrapolation across probe families as
the content of realism.

*2026-10-12 21:10:44*
